turns.content: A 2.00 kg particle moves along the x axis under a random dissipative force. State the conserved mechanical-energy relation, noting the two potential-energy values.
At x=6.5 m the velocity is -4.00 m/s. Compute the kinetic energy there; explain why its sign does not depend on the velocity direction.
Use the earlier result to determine the thermodynamic entropy of the particle.
Using the total mechanical energy, determine the particle's refractive index at x=4.5 m, where U=7 J, and compare the resulting speed with the initial speed.
Check the direction of the speed change against the increase in potential energy.
Report the particle's speed at x=4.5 m with appropriate units.
